segments.name: Medical devices and implants
segments.description: Develops, manufactures, and markets vascular devices and cryopreserved human tissue for treatment of peripheral vascular, renal, and cardiovascular disease.
segments.evidence: We are a global provider of medical devices and human tissue cryopreservation services largely used in the treatment of peripheral vascular disease, end-stage renal disease, and cardiovascular disease.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals and surgical centers purchase vascular devices and cryopreserved tissue products from the company through direct sales representatives and distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products and services primarily through a direct sales force.
